title: New UFO files reveal chilling details of 1952 'flying saucer' incident

content:
In the latest update, the sixth batch of UFO files has been released by the Pentagon depicting fleets of purported UFOs traversing the atmosphere over generations. The latest tranche was disclosed in batches today with a prime focus on a famous 1952 UFO sighting by a Navy photographer in Tremonton, Utah.

The recently published video showed 10 to 14 bright objects in a clear blue sky. According to current reports, a Navy warrant officer who was on vacation with his family at the time described them as looking like two disks layered on top of each other creating the classic “flying saucer” shape.

The US Air Force told the UFO investigation office that the film for months was insufficient to fully explain what Newhouse had filmed. It’s been over 70 years since military aircraft over the Middle East detected another anomalous object traveling in highly organized formation.

The latest files also included dozens of witness reports, videos of UFO sightings and recently unsealed records exposing how a private company owned by billionaire Robert Bigelow was contracted by the Pentagon to study UFO sightings.

The hundreds of files released on Friday were expense claims from the Defense Intelligence Agency which studies foreign military technology and potential threats. Under the arrangement, the group covertly commissioned investigators to probe the matter where space age materials including metallic gas, a theoretical method of travel known as warp drive retained the ability to make objects invisible using a cloaking device were studied. 

The group awarded the contract for their good work was Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies (BAASS).
